results.text: Effect of hemoglobin A1c change on 24-month clinical outcomes in patients with diabetes after acute myocardial infarction. The average glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) may not accurately reflect glycemic control status during the mid-term after acute myocardial infarction (AMI). We aimed to evaluate changes in HbA1c and their effect on mid-term clinical outcomes in patients with diabetes and AMI.
